points.point: R&S VNA 的每條規格必須標示型號與文件版次，且數字要連測試條件一起抄，不可自行補齊原文沒有的 option code 或料號
points.label: partial
points.why: states formal R&S spec, model/version, conditions; omits no invented option/part numbers

points.point: 比較時必須區分 specification / typical / nominal / measured 等級，因為來源明示 R&S 不保證 non-traceable specifications、typical、nominal、measured 值
points.label: covered
points.why: separates warranted/spec from typical/nominal/measured and says not guaranteed

points.point: 性能數字（如 dynamic range）必須附上量測條件，例如 measurement bandwidth 與是否套用 user correction
points.label: partial
points.why: requires measurement conditions and bandwidth, but omits user correction detail

points.point: Vault 對競品 VNA（Keysight PNA）的唯一來源未列型號、頻率範圍、option code 或校準件，且未提供任何性能指標，不足以支撐規格對比
points.label: partial
points.why: says Keysight source insufficient and lacks model/frequency/cal kit, but omits option code/performance metrics explicitly

points.point: R&S 內部 battle card 對競品的描述屬單一來源，用於客戶文件前需以競品官方資料或第三方資料驗證
points.label: covered
points.why: warns battle-card positioning is not binding and asks for official competitor specs/test reports

points.point: only platform、leadership、lower TCO 等 sales language 不可當作可驗證技術規格，且 TCO 主張沒有算式或實證資料
points.label: partial
points.why: rejects sales positioning as proof, but does not mention only platform/leadership/lower TCO or missing TCO formula

points.point: 半導體相關的 ZNA / ZNA67EXT 對應只來自 Excel solution mapping，該欄不是正式 datasheet / application note / configuration guide，不得據此報價或建立測試配置，也未提供 option / fixture / calibration 條件
points.label: contradicted
points.why: uses semiconductor/PCB case lines instead of noting only Excel mapping and its limitations

points.point: 半導體客戶與 R&S solution 同列不代表已購買、評估、合作或導入，不能作為客戶實證
points.label: contradicted
points.why: treats company/project listings as sales-case evidence rather than warning they are not customer proof

invented: available case data is only partial sales-case evidence
Bare board for SoCs (RFIC) ... companies are suppliers of Samsung Electronics
Meritech is listed as a PCB manufacturer using ZNA43 for PCB test with probing
